stem: Which of the following was a significant effect of New Deal legislation?

options.label: A
options.text: Income tax rates fell to historic lows.

options.label: B
options.text: The federal government took on new roles.

options.label: C
options.text: The regulation of intrastate trade was transferred to the states.

options.label: D
options.text: States became the sole enforcers of immigration law.
